note: Stage-5D bounded navigation campaign. The two arms differ in exactly one line of one file: tracker_params.yaml vs stage5d_classaware_tracker.yaml, reachability_class_aware false -> true. The nav2 params file -- hence MPPI and every critic weight, the planner, the costmap geometry and resolution, and prediction_mode: reachability -- is the SAME FILE for both arms, so MPPI cannot have been tuned per arm. Map, world, start, goal, obstacle body, obstacle trajectory, release time, sensor model, AMCL, the Kalman filter, the CV predictor, the Stage-5B classifier, compound clustering, the reachability mathematics and the Stage-5C.1 contract are shared by construction. Ground truth is used by the trial runner for scoring and for commanding the scripted obstacle only, and never reaches /scan, the tracker, the costmap layer, the planner or the controller.
